patch.sql:
select
    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
patch.explanation: The not_null_stg_orders_order_date test failed with 363 null order_date values. In stg_orders the order_date column is set using a CASE that nulls the date when order_status = 'P'. The not_null test expects every order to have a date, so the CASE is wrong. Raw.orders has no null order_date values. Changing the model to map o_orderdate directly removes the nulls, and a try_patch run shows all checks now pass.
patch.original:
select
    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    case when o_orderstatus <> 'P' then o_orderdate end as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_date IS NULL) AS null_order_date FROM raw.orders
